rationale: Compulsory central annual-accounts register: the only systematic financials for MK vendor entities, but statements are fee/account gated.
Beneficial-ownership register exposes owners behind MK payments/IT firms and reseller proxies; search access must be cleared first.
Recurring registry statistical bulletin gives NKD-level population sizing for the MK IT/payments vendor base.
Transactional e-filing front-end on crm.com.mk; procedural context only, no standalone signal stream.
Name-reservation lookup is a distinct query service and an early-warning signal of foreign payments-brand market entry.
Related-entities/officer certificates are a CRM service page; valuable ownership graph but issued on paid request.
Open machine-readable mirror of MK entity records; good triage/cross-border matching layer, partial coverage.
Curated one-off inventory of MK official registries — mine for registry leads, then archive.
Recurring national-statistics release series on active business entities by NKD; denominator for vendor-population analysis.
Exchange disclosure archive carries audited bank reports naming IT/payments investments and vendors; continuous public feed.
MASIT about-us section duplicated by the member directory and news pages already covered on the same domain.
Service catalogue enumerating CRM services, fees and access conditions — mine once to plan legal obtainability.
Single OGP commitment page; useful evidence on future registry openness but not a recurring vendor signal.
Commercial document-procurement intermediary; a paid fallback channel, low credibility and redundant with CRM itself.
One-off law-firm explainer on branch vs representative office — interpretive evidence for reading registry presence.
Banking association hub: member roster, events and programmes — the core census of the MK banking demand side.
Committee roster is a section of mba.mk already monitored; names payments/IT decision owners.
Quarterly e-Bulletin PDFs published under mba.mk; monitor the bulletin index on the parent domain rather than one issue.
SKIBOR reference-bank panel is an mba.mk sub-page; useful de-facto tiering of target accounts.
Paginated ICT chamber member census — the primary MK vendor/competitor lead list to mine into registry lookups.
Association news/positions feed surfaces partnerships and policy ahead of contracts; URL check failed, recheck liveness.
Leadership roster on the MASIT homepage; maps leading ICT firms but no independent stream from the parent domain.
National chamber hub with news, events and sector groupings; continuous output plus pointers to actor lists.
Broadest MK financial-sector membership frame (banks, leasing, NBFI) — harvest the actor list, monitor the chamber parent.
Non-bank financial companies group: distinct fintech-adjacent buyer pool for payments/self-service tech; mine the roster.
Insurance-broker association roster widens the adjacent buyer map for digital onboarding/payment technology.
Alternative-lender trade body with its own membership and self-regulation output; URL verification failed, recheck reachability.
